description: An invariant whose pure `fn` reads a cell through another `fn`: E-CONTRACT-003 naming the chain — a `fn` called from an invariant reads exactly what the invariant may read directly.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-struct-invariant-syntax ("yes, your recommendations on all three plus the follow-up"); ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-struct-invariant-contract ("RULED yes (a)")
rationale: §66.13.5 rule 7 (r1): a `fn` called from an invariant, directly or through other `fn`s, reads no cell (E-CONTRACT-003, rule 6) and no outer binding; otherwise a write to `@limit` could break a stored value's invariant with nothing re-checking it.
